title: Bulk throughput: tool output scheduled at 4 MiB/s per session
description: One phase forever: 16 KiB tool-output chunks 256 times a second. That is more than a host is expected to drain at N = 15, so delivered_ratio and producer_stall_pct read the host's throughput ceiling rather than the profile's rate.

provenance.source: Plan D3: throughput - 16 KiB compiler/test/log-line chunks at 256 per second (4 MiB/s scheduled per session).
